### Quick Info

## Overview

The next International Symposium on Radiative Transfer is announced for
**Le Croisic**, on the Atlantic coast near Nantes, from **19 to 23 June 2028**.
The series, organised by the International Centre for Heat and Mass Transfer
(ICHMT), is the reference meeting of the radiative-transfer community; the
previous editions were [RAD-25](/events-news/conferences/2025-rad-25-11th-international-symposium-on-radiative-transfer.html)
in Kuşadası and [RAD-23](/events-news/conferences/2023-rad-23-10th-international-symposium-on-radiative-transfer.html)
in Thessaloniki.

**Status:** announced; there is no symposium website yet. Dates and venue as
communicated by Benoît Rousseau (CNRS, LTeN Nantes; coordinator of
[TAMARYS](/network/networks/tamarys.html)) in October 2026. This entry will be
updated when the organisers publish the call.
